what: replay of one scheduler result on a demonstration station layout; not an operating plan, not flight paths
travel_rule: straight line; slots = max(1, ceil(distance / 900 m)); no routing
legs_format: per UAV (order of sorted ids): [slot_from, slot_to, from_station_index, to_station_index] for flight segments only

display.note: flight height is a display choice, not part of the schedule; no obstacle or airspace check
display.parking: a standing UAV is drawn on its own spot near the station pad: park[station][uav] = [x, y, ground z], spots on a 3 m lattice, nearest first, on ground cells of the 8 m flood-model masks that are not building or water

scheduler.run_note: run by CD on the GPU workstation, backend mean_field, device cuda, seed 20261112, published defaults, 150.4 s; checked by the scheduler's own replay and by an independent event and battery replay
